description: Every battery case over a corpus made up of nothing but the hand-authored edge documents. This is where the mandatory §8.2 coverage lives: geo boundary/vertex/missing-geopoint, vectors and hybrid, email tokenization, equal sort keys, distinct groups, null vs absent, empty string/array, the 64-character token cap.

vectors.name: where.string.eq
vectors.notes: Report §6: Orama returns the empty set for {eq} on a scalar string.

vectors.name: where.string.in
vectors.notes: Report §6: {in} on a string field is a silent empty set in Orama.

vectors.name: where.string.not_in_missing_field
vectors.notes: not_in requires the field to be PRESENT — missing/null must fail it.

vectors.name: where.string.numeric_string_eq
vectors.notes: Numeric-string probe: '5' must not coerce to 5 (plan §5 coercion rule).

vectors.name: where.string.numeric_number_against_string_field
vectors.notes: The other half of the probe: 5 must not match the string '5'.

vectors.name: where.string.astral_eq
vectors.notes: Astral-plane equality; the ordering counterpart lives in order.*.

vectors.name: where.number.bare
vectors.notes: Plain number normalizes to {eq} (plan §5 normalization).

vectors.name: where.number.between_reversed
vectors.notes: Reversed bounds: freeze as empty, not as a swapped range.

vectors.name: where.number.multiple_ops
vectors.notes: Report §E: Orama throws INVALID_FILTER_OPERATION for two ops in one object.

vectors.name: where.number.multiple_ops_three
vectors.notes: Three simultaneous operators — all must AND together.

vectors.name: where.number.null_and_absent
vectors.notes: A positive predicate must exclude both null and absent ratings.

vectors.name: where.boolean.eq_true
vectors.notes: json_extract returns 0/1 for booleans — the SQL compiler must coerce (plan §5).

vectors.name: where.boolean.absent_field
vectors.notes: edge_bool_absent must NOT match false — absent is not false.

vectors.name: where.boolean_array.eq_false
vectors.notes: Report §6: {eq} on an array field is a silent empty set in Orama; ours means "contains".

vectors.name: where.enum.bare
vectors.notes: Report §E: a bare value on an enum throws in Orama; normalizeWhere papers over it.

vectors.name: where.enum.numeric_value_as_string
vectors.notes: Numeric enum: '3' must not match 3.

vectors.name: where.enum_array.contains_all_empty_list
vectors.notes: Vacuously true, or empty? Freeze it here.

vectors.name: where.enum_array.eq
vectors.notes: Report §6: Orama throws for {eq} on enum[]; ours means "contains".

vectors.name: where.enum_array.bare_value
vectors.notes: Report §6: a bare value on enum[] throws Invalid operation in Orama.

vectors.name: where.enum_array.not_in
vectors.notes: Present AND no element in the list — an empty array field still counts as present.

vectors.name: where.enum_array.empty_array_doc
vectors.notes: edge_null_rating carries label_ids: [] and must never match contains_any.

vectors.name: where.string_array.eq
vectors.notes: Report §6: silent empty set in Orama; ours means "contains".

vectors.name: where.string_array.in
vectors.notes: Report §6: {in} on string[] is a silent empty set in Orama; ours is contains-any.

vectors.name: where.string_array.contains_all
vectors.notes: Report §6: contains_all works only on enum[] in Orama.

vectors.name: where.string_array.contains_any
vectors.notes: Report §6: contains_any works only on enum[] in Orama.

vectors.name: where.string_array.hyphenated_value
vectors.notes: Filtering is exact-value, never tokenized — the hyphen must survive.

vectors.name: where.number_array.empty_array_doc
vectors.notes: An empty number[] must not match any positive element predicate.

vectors.name: where.and.empty
vectors.notes: Report §7: Orama evaluates both and:[] and or:[] to the empty set.

vectors.name: where.not.eq_missing_field_passes
vectors.notes: Report §7: not complements over the CORPUS, so missing-field docs pass.

vectors.name: where.not.not_in
vectors.notes: not(not_in) is NOT eq — missing-field docs pass the outer not.

vectors.name: where.leaf_and_composite_siblings
vectors.notes: A leaf key alongside a composite key in the same object — freeze as AND.

vectors.name: term.prefix.default
vectors.notes: Prefix expansion: data/database/dataset/datum all match, each contributing (report §4).

vectors.name: term.exact.case_mixed
vectors.notes: Report §C: Orama exact is case-SENSITIVE and never matches arrays; ours is neither.

vectors.name: term.exact.on_array_field
vectors.notes: Report §C: Orama silently returns nothing for exact on array fields.

vectors.name: term.tolerance.one
vectors.notes: hello/hallo at distance 1 must both match, at full weight (report §3).

vectors.name: term.tolerance.with_exact
vectors.notes: Report §3: exact:true suppresses tolerance entirely — never combined.

vectors.name: term.tolerance.short_token_boundary
vectors.notes: Tolerance ≥ token length: everything short is within distance.

vectors.name: term.tolerance.long_token
vectors.notes: Query-side truncation to 64 chars must mirror the doc side (plan §4.1 step 5).

vectors.name: term.threshold.default
vectors.notes: Absent threshold defaults to 1 → the full union.

vectors.name: term.threshold.zero
vectors.notes: Report §5 quirk 1: Orama requires all tokens within ONE field; ours is per-document, so edge_threshold_split_fields is INCLUDED here and excluded in Orama.

vectors.name: term.threshold.half
vectors.notes: Report §5: the fractional blend inherits the per-document deviation of threshold 0.

vectors.name: term.threshold.quarter
vectors.notes: Report §5: ceil(|U \ A| * t) must still admit at least one partial match.

vectors.name: term.threshold.zero_token_matches_nothing
vectors.notes: One token matching nothing ⇒ empty under both readings (report §5).

vectors.name: term.threshold.fraction_with_empty_all_set
vectors.notes: Report §5 quirk 3: Orama skips the fraction when A is empty; we always apply it.

vectors.name: term.threshold.prefix_expansion_quirk
vectors.notes: Report §5 quirk 2: in Orama, "al" expanding to two index words spuriously satisfies "all tokens" for edge_threshold_prefix_quirk. We count distinct query tokens.

vectors.name: term.enum_never_matches
vectors.notes: Report §2: enum values never participate in term matching.

vectors.name: term.repeated_words.tf
vectors.notes: Report §A: Orama de-duplicates tokens so repetition RAISES the score; we keep duplicates so tf is a real term frequency.

vectors.name: term.email.full_address
vectors.notes: Whole address token + split parts; the union balloons under threshold 1 (plan §4.1).

vectors.name: term.email.tld_only
vectors.notes: Every email-bearing doc shares the `com` token — deliberate membership balloon.

vectors.name: term.punctuation.apostrophe
vectors.notes: Plan §4.1 (2026-08-12): an intra-word apostrophe FOLDS, so `jane’s` is the single token `janes` — no stray `s`. Orama treats `’` as a separator and matches every `jane*` document.

vectors.name: term.punctuation.apostrophe_less_query
vectors.notes: The folded token is what is indexed, so the apostrophe-less spelling matches it exactly; Orama indexed `jane` + `s` and finds nothing for `janes`.

vectors.name: term.punctuation.hyphen
vectors.notes: Report §1: Orama keeps `-`; we split into `well` + `known`.

vectors.name: term.punctuation.snake_case
vectors.notes: Report §1: Orama keeps `_`; we split.

vectors.name: term.punctuation.snake_case_part
vectors.notes: Report §1: `snake` matches only because we split on underscore and Orama does not.

vectors.name: term.camel_case.whole_token
vectors.notes: Plan §4.1 (2026-08-12): a camelCase chunk emits the whole lowercased token as well as its parts, so the literal spelling still matches.

vectors.name: term.camel_case.part
vectors.notes: Plan §4.1 (2026-08-12): camelCase parts are indexed; Orama has no case-boundary rule, so `widget` finds nothing there.

vectors.name: term.camel_case.acronym_boundary
vectors.notes: Plan §4.1 (2026-08-12): the `\p{Lu}\p{Lu}\p{Ll}` boundary splits `HTTPServer` into `http` + `server`. `server` is the half Orama cannot reach — its single `httpserver` token only prefix-matches `http`.

vectors.name: term.format_characters.soft_hyphen
vectors.notes: Plan §4.1 (2026-08-12): `\p{Cf}` folds to nothing, so a soft-hyphenated word is one token; Orama treats the soft hyphen as a separator.

vectors.name: term.format_characters.zero_width_joiner
vectors.notes: Plan §4.1 (2026-08-12): same rule, with U+200D inside the word.

vectors.name: term.acronym_dots.folded
vectors.notes: Plan §4.1 (2026-08-12): `U.S.A.` folds to `usa`; Orama splits it into three single-letter tokens.

vectors.name: term.acronym_dots.query_spelling
vectors.notes: The query side folds identically, so the dotted spelling is the same single token.

vectors.name: term.number_chunk.decimal
vectors.notes: Plan §4.1 (2026-08-12): a separator-bearing numeric chunk emits the whole chunk plus its digit runs, so `3.14` is findable as one token.

vectors.name: term.number_chunk.exact_decimal
vectors.notes: Plan §4.1 (2026-08-12): only the whole-chunk token makes an exact `3.14` match possible; Orama indexes `3` and `14` only.

vectors.name: term.number_chunk.grouped_thousands
vectors.notes: Same rule with a comma separator; the extra whole-chunk token changes membership against Orama.

vectors.name: term.punctuation.modifier_apostrophe
vectors.notes: Plan §4.1 (2026-08-12): U+02BC joins the apostrophe fold class, so `johnʼs` is the single token `johns`. Orama treats it as a separator and matches every `john*` document.

vectors.name: term.punctuation.modifier_apostrophe_less_query
vectors.notes: The folded token is what is indexed, so the apostrophe-less spelling matches exactly; Orama indexed `john` + `s`.

vectors.name: term.unicode.diacritic_folded
vectors.notes: NFKD + mark stripping folds café → cafe; Orama only folds U+00C0–U+017F.

vectors.name: term.unicode.diacritic_literal
vectors.notes: The query side folds identically to the doc side, so café and cafe are one token.

vectors.name: term.unicode.umlaut
vectors.notes: Report §1: Orama shreds Zürich into `z` + `rich`; ours folds to `zurich`.

vectors.name: term.unicode.cjk
vectors.notes: Report §1: Orama indexes no CJK at all.

vectors.name: term.unicode.cyrillic
vectors.notes: Report §1: Cyrillic is destroyed by Orama's splitter; ours indexes it.

vectors.name: term.unicode.astral
vectors.notes: Emoji are outside \p{L}\p{N} — the term tokenizes to nothing.

vectors.name: term.long_token.over_64_chars
vectors.notes: edge_long_token and edge_long_token_twin truncate to the SAME 64-char token.

vectors.name: term.empty_string
vectors.notes: An empty term tokenizes to nothing — freeze whether that means "all" or "none".

vectors.name: term.whitespace_only
vectors.notes: Frozen answer: whitespace tokenizes to no tokens → no term constraint → full corpus, same as `term: ""`. Orama returns ∅ for a non-empty term that tokenizes to nothing.

vectors.name: facets.number.overlapping_ranges
vectors.notes: Overlapping ranges: a doc counts in both buckets.

vectors.name: facets.with_where
vectors.notes: Counted over the full matched set, after where, before limit (plan §4.8).

vectors.name: facets.with_limit_offset_ignored
vectors.notes: Facet counts must ignore limit/offset entirely.

vectors.name: distinct.count_semantics
vectors.notes: Report §D: Orama reports the PRE-distinct count; we freeze post-distinct.

vectors.name: distinct.on_boolean_field
vectors.notes: edge_bool_absent has no value — freeze whether absent forms its own group.

vectors.name: order.default_direction
vectors.notes: Direction defaults to ASC.

vectors.name: order.string.asc
vectors.notes: Code-POINT order, not UTF-16 code-unit order: U+1F600 must sort after U+FFFD (plan §4.6).

vectors.name: order.nulls_last_asc
vectors.notes: null AND absent sort LAST regardless of direction (plan §4.6).

vectors.name: order.boolean
vectors.notes: false < true; absent last.

vectors.name: order.equal_values_pk_tiebreak
vectors.notes: String PK: '10' sorts before '2'.

vectors.name: order.equal_updated_at_desc
vectors.notes: The dominant real-world path — DEFAULT_SEARCH_QUERY orders updated_at DESC.

vectors.name: order.with_term_overrides_score
vectors.notes: order[] wins over BM25 ordering when present (plan §4.6).

vectors.name: paging.walk.page_0
vectors.notes: Three consecutive pages must partition the ordered result set.

vectors.name: paging.walk.page_1
vectors.notes: Three consecutive pages must partition the ordered result set.

vectors.name: paging.walk.page_2
vectors.notes: Three consecutive pages must partition the ordered result set.

vectors.name: paging.limit_zero
vectors.notes: The server clamps limit to 1..5000 (plan §4.7) — freeze what 0 does.

vectors.name: geo.radius.boundary_inclusive
vectors.notes: edge_geo_boundary_exact sits EXACTLY on this radius; inside:true is `distance <= value` (report §8).

vectors.name: geo.radius.boundary_exclusive
vectors.notes: inside:false is `distance > value` — the exact complement over INDEXED points.

vectors.name: geo.radius.unit.cm
vectors.notes: Every unit expresses the same boundary distance — all six must agree.

vectors.name: geo.radius.unit.m
vectors.notes: Every unit expresses the same boundary distance — all six must agree.

vectors.name: geo.radius.unit.km
vectors.notes: Every unit expresses the same boundary distance — all six must agree.

vectors.name: geo.radius.unit.ft
vectors.notes: Every unit expresses the same boundary distance — all six must agree.

vectors.name: geo.radius.unit.yd
vectors.notes: Every unit expresses the same boundary distance — all six must agree.

vectors.name: geo.radius.unit.mi
vectors.notes: Every unit expresses the same boundary distance — all six must agree.

vectors.name: geo.radius.zero
vectors.notes: Only docs exactly at the centre (distance 0 <= 0).

vectors.name: geo.radius.huge
vectors.notes: Half the planet — but missing/null geopoints still must not match.

vectors.name: geo.radius.missing_geopoint_excluded
vectors.notes: Report §10: edge_geo_missing and edge_geo_null fail BOTH directions.

vectors.name: geo.radius.not_composite_admits_missing
vectors.notes: Report §10 contrast: `not` complements over the CORPUS, so missing-geo docs pass.

vectors.name: geo.radius.high_precision_ignored
vectors.notes: highPrecision is accepted and ignored — we are always haversine (report §8).

vectors.name: geo.polygon.inside
vectors.notes: Report §9 half-open boundary: bottom edge, left edge and the bottom-left vertex are INSIDE; top/right edges and the top-right vertex are OUTSIDE.

vectors.name: geo.polygon.outside
vectors.notes: Exact complement over INDEXED points — missing/null geopoints still excluded.

vectors.name: geo.polygon.explicit_closing_vertex
vectors.notes: The ring is implicitly closed — repeating the first vertex must change nothing.

vectors.name: geo.polygon.degenerate_two_points
vectors.notes: A degenerate ring encloses nothing — freeze it as empty rather than an error.

vectors.name: geo.polygon.antimeridian
vectors.notes: Report §9: planar math spans the LONG way, so edge_anti_zero matches and edge_anti_east does not. Assert the defined planar result, never a geographic one.

vectors.name: vector.default_similarity
vectors.notes: Report §11: similarity defaults to 0.8, so cosine 0.79 drops out and 0.80 stays.

vectors.name: vector.similarity_080
vectors.notes: The boundary doc has cosine exactly 0.8 — admitted (`>= similarity`).

vectors.name: vector.similarity_zero
vectors.notes: Even at 0, docs with no vector (edge_vec_missing) must not appear.

vectors.name: vector.non_unit_query
vectors.notes: Query vectors normalize at query time — scaling must not change the ranking.

vectors.name: vector.non_unit_document
vectors.notes: edge_vec_non_unit is [3,0,...] and must score 1.0 after write-time normalization.

vectors.name: hybrid.term_and_vector
vectors.notes: Report §12: max-normalize each set, then 0.5 * text + 0.5 * vector, then PK-ascending tie-break.

vectors.name: hybrid.with_similarity_floor
vectors.notes: Report §11: the floor applies inside hybrid — filtered docs contribute 0.

vectors.name: hybrid.term_matches_nothing
vectors.notes: Report §12: an empty/zero-max score set must be guarded, not produce NaN/-0.

vectors.name: combination.sparse_false
vectors.notes: sparse:false hydrates the full row — membership and order must be unchanged.

vectors.name: order.integer_pk_tiebreak
vectors.notes: Integer PK: events 1, 2 and 10 tie on every sort key — 2 must precede 10.

error_vectors.name: where.error.contains_all_on_scalar
error_vectors.expected_message_contains: The `contains_all` filter only applies to array fields, not "status".
error_vectors.notes: Report §6 matrix: contains_all on a scalar field is a 400.

error_vectors.name: where.error.geo_operator_on_number
error_vectors.expected_message_contains: The `radius` filter only applies to geopoint fields, not "view_count".

error_vectors.name: term.fields.error_enum_field
error_vectors.expected_message_contains: Field "status" is a enum — only string fields can be searched.
error_vectors.notes: Report §2: naming an enum field in `fields` is a 400, not a silent no-op.

error_vectors.name: geo.radius.error_unknown_unit
error_vectors.expected_message_contains: Invalid distance unit "nm". Valid units are: cm, m, km, mi, yd, ft.

error_vectors.name: vector.error.non_vector_field
error_vectors.expected_message_contains: Field "title" is not a vector field.

error_vectors.name: vector.error.dimension_mismatch
error_vectors.expected_message_contains: Vector dimension mismatch: query has 3, index has 8.

error_vectors.name: vector.error.zero_query_vector
error_vectors.expected_message_contains: A zero vector cannot be indexed — cosine similarity is undefined for it.
error_vectors.notes: Plan §4.9: zero vectors are rejected — cosine is undefined for them.
